sources.title: Ornith-1.0: Self-Scaffolding LLMs for Agentic Coding | Ornith Blog | Jun. 2026
sources.snippet: Each RL step proceeds in two stages: conditioned on a task and the scaffold previously used for it, the model first proposes a refined scaffold; conditioned on that scaffold and the task description, it then generates a solution rollout. Reward from the rollout is propagated to both stages, so the model is optimized not only to produce better answers but to author the orchestration that elicits them.
